cinematic_philosophy: Grounded Eastern Xianxia Realism (Cổ Phong Tiên Hiệp Điện Ảnh Chân Thực) inspired by the atmospheric depth of Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon and Shadow, avoiding garish mobile-game neon or cartoon tropes.

white_cultivator_inner.name: Pale Cloud Azure
white_cultivator_inner.role: Protagonist inner collar and silk trim

black_cultivator_metal.name: Aged Meteoric Iron
black_cultivator_metal.role: Hair clasp, broadsword blade, belt buckle

color_palette.saturation_limits: Robe and environment saturation capped at 25%; Qi energy luminosity contrast elevated while maintaining naturalistic diffusion
color_palette.contrast_profile: Cinematic log curve with deep natural blacks (not crushed to 0) and protected highlights

sword_white_cultivator.name: Thanh Sương Kiếm (Phá Vân Kiếm)
sword_white_cultivator.type: Slender Double-Edged Straight Sword (Tiên Hiệp Trường Kiếm)
sword_white_cultivator.materials: Folded Damascus patterned cold steel, hilt of carved white mutton-fat jade wrapped with fine silver wire, guard with cloud-relief chasing
sword_white_cultivator.scabbard: Lacquered white hornbeam wood mounted with engraved silver throat, chape, and dual suspension bands
sword_white_cultivator.visual_dynamics: Gleams with crisp cold specular reflection along blade ridge; leaves subtle micro-reflections in misty air

sword_black_cultivator.name: Huyền Minh Kiếm (Trảm Đoán Trọng Kiếm)
sword_black_cultivator.type: Heavy Two-Handed Cleaving Broadsword (Hắc Thiết Trọng Kiếm)
sword_black_cultivator.materials: Forged dark meteoric iron with deep fuller/blood-groove, hilt wrapped in dark grey stingray skin, heavy forged iron counterweight pommel
sword_black_cultivator.scabbard: Aged dark bronze-trimmed oxhide sheath with wide cross-back harness
sword_black_cultivator.visual_dynamics: Matte gunmetal finish absorbs light; creates heavy displacement wake in mist during fast swings

pale_azure_qi.geometry: Razor-thin crystalline filaments, needles, and laminar ribbons adhering closely to blade edge (2-5cm offset)
pale_azure_qi.behavior: Condenses silently; hums with high-frequency harmonic vibration; slices cleanly through mist leaving crisp negative voids
pale_azure_qi.decay: Evaporates into fine crystalline light dust within 0.4 seconds of motion completion

dark_purple_qi.geometry: Dense turbulent vapor and gravitational shockwave rings radiating 30-60cm from broadsword face
dark_purple_qi.behavior: Distorts background mist like heat-shimmer; creates radial ground pressure waves skimming across flagstones
dark_purple_qi.decay: Dissolves into dark smoky mist wisps that dissipate into ambient fog

collision_dynamics.impact_spark_profile: Sharp amber/white particle sparks bursting radially at blade contact point (X04, X07)
collision_dynamics.barrier_shatter_x10: Geometric crystalline fracturing of dark qi shield into luminous purple and azure shards before vaporizing into clear dawn air

camera_and_optics_bible.sensor_format: Large Format Digital Cinema (43.8 x 30.2mm equivalent)

establishing_wide.character: Deep perspective, vast sea of clouds framing circular arena

full_dynamic_two_shot.character: Preserves full body martial silhouettes and clear 180-degree axis

medium_combat_engagements.character: Neutral human perspective, authentic physical weight transfer

intense_closeup_payoff.character: Shallow depth of field, crisp focus on eye intensity, blade tip, and weapon collision

camera_and_optics_bible.shutter_discipline: Strict 180-degree shutter (1/48s at 24fps) to preserve naturalistic organic motion blur on rapid blade extensions

prohibited_visual_drifts: No oversaturated neon effects or cartoon cell-shading
No video-game style HUD, damage numbers, or glowing magical rings on ground
No flying swords swarming the sky (only the two physical weapons wielded in hand)
No anime spiky hair or gravity-defying floating clothing in still poses
No modern military tactical vests, boots, or tactical gloves
No gore, severed limbs, or graphic blood splatters (duel resolves with honor and concession)
